jobs.title: Regional Sales Specialist — Dental & Aesthetics
jobs.summary: Develop dental and aesthetics accounts across Malaysia and Singapore, with focus on clinic engagement, product demonstrations and revenue growth.
jobs.description: This role supports Curative's regional dental and aesthetics portfolio, including imaging systems, professional skincare, injection-support products and clinic technologies. The role is suitable for a commercially driven candidate who can build relationships with clinics, arrange demonstrations, follow up quotations and coordinate with internal clinical and marketing teams.
requirements: Experience in medical, dental, aesthetics, pharmaceutical or healthcare sales
Able to manage clinic visits, demonstrations, quotations and follow-up independently
Good communication skills in English; Mandarin or Bahasa Malaysia is an advantage
Comfortable travelling for customer visits, training and regional events
benefits: Regional exposure across Curative's healthcare portfolio

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Sales Specialist — Ophthalmology
jobs.summary: Support ophthalmology customers across IOLs, cataract surgery consumables, surgical instruments and clinical product adoption.
jobs.description: This role works with eye clinics, hospitals and surgical teams to support Curative's ophthalmology portfolio. Responsibilities include account development, product education, operating theatre support coordination, stock planning and follow-up with doctors, nurses and procurement teams.
requirements: Experience in ophthalmology, medical device sales, clinical applications or operating theatre support
Strong follow-up discipline with doctors, nurses, purchasing teams and internal operations
Able to learn technical product details and communicate them clearly
Singapore healthcare or medical device market experience is preferred
